Sharpie on paper

About this piece

One high school art class assignment was to produce a fully black-and-white image based on something we found in a magazine. I found a full-page magazine ad for an SUV, loved the low-fidelity relief (plus, nature!), and decided to recreate it with Sharpie for this assignment.
